div.head: Quadr Arg 9
div.ab: Tandem reuocato Eadwardo, Aðelredi regis filio, mediante Alwino Wintoniensi episcopo et Godwino comite, conuocatis apud Hursteshevet totius Angliæ baronibus, ita demum in regem suscipiendus auditur, si eis Cnudi leges et filiorum eius inconuulsa stabilitate suo tempore mansuras iuramenti satisfactione sanciret.

div.ab: At length, Edward, son of King Æthelred, having been recalled through the mediation of Alwine bishop of Winchester and Earl Godwine, and the barons of all England having been convoked at Hursteshevet, it was heard that he was to be received as king only on condition that he should ratify for them by the satisfaction of an oath that the laws of Cnut and of his sons would remain in his time with unshaken stability.
